name: envoy-mark
title: Envoy Mark (SVG)
description: The envoyai badge mark as a standalone SVG asset, for favicons, og images and static use.

files.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 40 40" width="40" height="40" role="img" aria-label="envoyai mark">
  <title>envoyai mark</title>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="mark-bg" x1="4" y1="4" x2="36" y2="36" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a1a1a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mark-leaf-top" x1="12" y1="24" x2="31" y2="8" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9a9a9a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mark-leaf-bottom" x1="28" y1="15" x2="9" y2="32" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a4a4a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d8d8d8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mark-streak" x1="4" y1="36" x2="36" y2="4" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="mark-clip">
      <rect x="1" y="1" width="38" height="38" rx="10"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>
  <rect x="1" y="1" width="38" height="38" rx="10" fill="url(#mark-bg)" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="0.75"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#mark-clip)">
    <rect x="-4" y="-4" width="48" height="48" fill="url(#mark-streak)"/>
    <path d="M13 25C10 22 10 17 13 14C16 11 20 12 22 10C25 8 27 7 30 9C27 12 23 14 20 16C17 18 15 21 13 25Z" fill="url(#mark-leaf-top)"/>
    <path d="M27 15C30 18 30 23 27 26C24 29 20 28 18 30C15 32 13 33 10 31C13 28 17 26 20 24C23 22 25 19 27 15Z" fill="url(#mark-leaf-bottom)"/>
  </g>
</svg>
